arxiv-1806-02218.title: Another (wrong) construction of π \pi
arxiv-1806-02218.creator: Zoltán Kovács
arxiv-1806-02218.description: Abstract A simple way is shown to construct the length π \pi from the unit length with 4 digits accuracy. 1 Introduction It is well-known that accurate construction of the ratio between the perimeter and the diameter of a circle is theoretically impossible [ 1 , 2 ] .

arxiv-2012-14682.title: CascadeBERT: Accelerating Inference of Pre-trained Language Models via Calibrated Complete Models Cascade
arxiv-2012-14682.description: Abstract Dynamic early exiting aims to accelerate the inference of pre-trained language models (PLMs) by emitting predictions in internal layers without passing through the entire model. In this paper, we empirically analyze the working mechanism of dynamic early exiting and find that it faces a performance bottleneck under high speed-up ratios.

arxiv-2110-08503.title: Ascribing quantum system to Schwarzschild spacetime with naked singularity
arxiv-2110-08503.creator: Andrzej Góźdź, Aleksandra Pȩdrak, Włodzimierz Piechocki
arxiv-2110-08503.description: Abstract We quantize the Schwarzschild spacetime with naked singularity using the affine coherent states quantization method. The novelty of our approach is quantization of both temporal and spatial coordinates. Quantization smears the gravitational singularity indicated by the Kretschmann invariant avoiding its localization in the configuration space. This way we resolve the singularity problem of considered spacetime at quantum level.

arxiv-2203-06645.title: Low rank orthogonal bundles and quadric fibrations Thanks: The first named author was supported by the National Research Foundation of Korea: NRF-2020R1F1A1A01068699.
arxiv-2203-06645.creator: Insong Choe, George H. Hitching
arxiv-2203-06645.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Insong Choe, George H. Hitching. Let C C be a curve and V → C V\to C an orthogonal vector bundle of rank r r . For r ≤ 6 r\leq 6 , the structure of V V can be described using tensor, symmetric and exterior products of bundles of lower rank, essentially due to the existence of exceptional isomorphisms between Spin ⁡ ( r , ℂ ) \mathrm{Spin}(r,{\mathbb{C}}) and other groups for these r r .

arxiv-2210-02515.title: Learning with Limited Samples – Meta-Learning and Applications to Communication Systems
arxiv-2210-02515.creator: Lisha Chen, Sharu Theresa Jose, Ivana Nikoloska, Sangwoo Park, Tianyi Chen, Osvaldo Simeone
arxiv-2210-02515.description: Abstract Deep learning has achieved remarkable success in many machine learning tasks such as image classification, speech recognition, and game playing. However, these breakthroughs are often difficult to translate into real-world engineering systems because deep learning models require a massive number of training samples, which are costly to obtain in practice.

arxiv-2212-14617.title: The emergence and growth of the flux transport dynamo model of the sunspot cycle
arxiv-2212-14617.creator: Arnab Rai Choudhuri
arxiv-2212-14617.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Arnab Rai Choudhuri. The sunspot cycle is the magnetic cycle of the Sun produced by the dynamo process. A central idea of the solar dynamo is that the toroidal and the poloidal magnetic fields of the Sun sustain each other. We discuss the relevant observational data both for sunspots (which are manifestations of the toroidal field) and for the poloidal field of the Sun.

arxiv-2306-02797.title: Human-like Few-Shot Learning via Bayesian Reasoning over Natural Language
arxiv-2306-02797.creator: Kevin Ellis
arxiv-2306-02797.description: Abstract A core tension in models of concept learning is that the model must carefully balance the tractability of inference against the expressivity of the hypothesis class. Humans, however, can efficiently learn a broad range of concepts. We introduce a model of inductive learning that seeks to be human-like in that sense.

arxiv-2308-03411.title: A Horse with no Labels: Self-Supervised Horse Pose Estimation from Unlabelled Images and Synthetic Prior
arxiv-2308-03411.creator: Jose Sosa, David Hogg
arxiv-2308-03411.description: Abstract Obtaining labelled data to train deep learning methods for estimating animal pose is challenging. Recently, synthetic data has been widely used for pose estimation tasks, but most methods still rely on supervised learning paradigms utilising synthetic images and labels. Can training be fully unsupervised? Is a tiny synthetic dataset sufficient?

arxiv-2403-16888.title: Towards Balanced RGB-TSDF Fusion for Consistent Semantic Scene Completion by 3D RGB Feature Completion and a Classwise Entropy Loss Function
arxiv-2403-16888.creator: Laiyan Ding, Panwen Hu, Jie Li, Rui Huang
arxiv-2403-16888.description: Abstract Semantic Scene Completion (SSC) aims to jointly infer semantics and occupancies of 3D scenes. Truncated Signed Distance Function (TSDF), a 3D encoding of depth, has been a common input for SSC. Furthermore, RGB-TSDF fusion, seems promising since these two modalities provide color and geometry information, respectively.

arxiv-2404-04592.title: Quantum magnetic oscillations in the absence of closed electron trajectories
arxiv-2404-04592.creator: Z. E. Krix, O. A. Tkachenko, V. A. Tkachenko, D. Q. Wang, O. Klochan, A. R. Hamilton, O. P. Sushkov
arxiv-2404-04592.description: Abstract Quantum magnetic oscillations in crystals are typically understood in terms of Bohr-Sommerfeld quantisation, the frequency of oscillation is given by the area of a closed electron trajectory. However, since the 1970s, oscillations have been observed with frequencies that do not correspond to closed electron trajectories and this effect has remained not fully understood.

arxiv-2406-14955.title: ICLEval: Evaluating In-Context Learning Ability of Large Language Models
arxiv-2406-14955.creator: Wentong Chen, Yankai Lin, ZhenHao Zhou, HongYun Huang, Yantao Jia, Zhao Cao, Ji-Rong Wen
arxiv-2406-14955.description: Abstract In-Context Learning (ICL) is a critical capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) as it empowers them to comprehend and reason across interconnected inputs. Evaluating the ICL ability of LLMs can enhance their utilization and deepen our understanding of how this ability is acquired at the training stage.

arxiv-2407-18828.title: Binary orbit and disks properties of the RW Aur system using ALMA observations
arxiv-2407-18828.creator: N. T. Kurtovic, S. Facchini, M. Benisty, P. Pinilla, S. Cabrit, E. L. N. Jensen, C. Dougados, R. Booth, C. N. Kimmig, C. F. Manara, J. E. Rodriguez
arxiv-2407-18828.description: Abstract Context. The dynamical interactions between young binaries can perturb the material distribution of their circumstellar disks, and modify the planet formation process. In order to understand how planets form in multiple stellar systems, it is necessary to characterize both their binary orbit and their disks properties. Aims.

arxiv-2408-12146.title: Three-zero texture of quark-mass matrices as a solution to the strong CP problem
arxiv-2408-12146.creator: Qiuyue Liang, Risshin Okabe, Tsutomu T. Yanagida
arxiv-2408-12146.description: Abstract The strong charge-parity (CP) problem has been a long-standing problem in particle physics since 1976, illustrating the small CP-violation phase in quantum chromodynamics (QCD). The axion, based on the Peccei-Quinn mechanism, is the most popular solution to the problem.

arxiv-2505-04444.title: Normal mode analysis within relativistic massive transport
arxiv-2505-04444.creator: Xin Lin, Qiu-Ze Sun, Xin-Hui Wu, Jin Hu
arxiv-2505-04444.description: Abstract In this paper, we address the normal mode analysis of the linearized Boltzmann equation for massive particles in the relaxation time approximation. We find that the sound channel and the heat channel are coupled in the massive case, which contrasts with their decoupling in the massless relaxation time approximation.

arxiv-2505-18496.title: Strong coupling of chiral magnons in altermagnets
arxiv-2505-18496.creator: Zhejunyu Jin 1, Tianci Gong 1, Jie Liu 1, Huanhuan Yang 1, Zhaozhuo Zeng 1, Yunshan Cao 1, Peng Yan 1,2
arxiv-2505-18496.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhejunyu Jin 1, Tianci Gong 1, Jie Liu 1, Huanhuan Yang 1, Zhaozhuo Zeng 1, Yunshan Cao 1, Peng Yan 1,2. Altermagnets recently are identified as a new class of magnets that break the time-reversal symmetry without exhibiting net magnetization. The role of the dipole-dipole interaction (DDI) on their dynamical properties however is yet to be addressed.

arxiv-2506-09286.title: Causal Graph Recovery in Neuroimaging through Answer Set Programming
arxiv-2506-09286.creator: Mohammadsajad Abavisani, Kseniya Solovyeva, David Danks, Vince Calhoun, Sergey Plis
arxiv-2506-09286.description: Abstract Learning graphical causal structures from time series data presents significant challenges, especially when the measurement frequency does not match the causal timescale of the system. This often leads to a set of equally possible underlying causal graphs due to information loss from sub-sampling (i.e., not observing all possible states of the system throughout time).

arxiv-2507-15619.title: Dynamic Investigation of the New Quantum-Control-Assisted Reverse uncertainty relation
arxiv-2507-15619.creator: Qiyi Li, Shaoqiang Ma, Sansheng Wang, Xiao Zheng, Guofeng Zhang
arxiv-2507-15619.description: Abstract Recently, a new interesting concept of reverse uncertainty relation is introduced. Different from the normal uncertainty relation, the reverse one indicates that one cannot only prepare quantum states with joint small uncertainty, but also with joint great uncertainty for incompatible observables.

arxiv-2605-04546.title: Measurement-Device-Independent Entanglement Quantification in a Fully Connected Time-Bin Quantum Network
arxiv-2605-04546.creator: Lu Liu, Ling-Xuan Kong, Ze-Yang Lu, Xu-Jie Peng, Xiao-Xu Fang, He Lu

arxiv-2605-26894.title: SIMPC: Learning Self-Induced Mirror-Point Consistency for Unsupervised Point Cloud Denoising
arxiv-2605-26894.creator: Chengwei Zhang, Xueyi Zhang, Tao Jiang, Xinhao Xu, Wenjie Li, Fubo Zhang, Longyong Chen

pmc-10576059.title: Innovative geopolymer-based cold asphalt emulsion mixture as eco-friendly material
pmc-10576059.creator: Anmar Dulaimi, Shakir Al Busaltan, Md Azree Othuman Mydin, Dong Lu, Yasin Onuralp Özkılıç, Ramadhansyah Putra Jaya, Arman Ameen
pmc-10576059.description: In recent years, there has been a growing interest in cold asphalt emulsion mixture (CAEM) due to its numerous advantages, including reduced CO2 emissions, energy savings, and improved safety during construction and application. However, CAEM has often been considered inferior to hot mix asphalt (HMA) in terms of performance.

pmc-10594961.title: Tumor response assessment by measuring the single largest lesion per organ in advanced non-small cell lung cancer patients treated with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor
pmc-10594961.creator: Li-Na He, Tao Chen, Sha Fu, Yongluo Jiang, Xuanye Zhang, Chen Chen, Wei Du, Linfeng Luo, Anlin Li, Yixing Wang, Hui Yu, Yixin Zhou, Yuhong Wang, Yunpeng Yang, Yan Huang, Hongyun Zhao, Wenfeng Fang, Li Zhang, Shaodong Hong
pmc-10594961.description: Background:For Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST1.1), measuring up to two target lesions per organ is an arbitrary criterion.Objectives:We sought to compare response assessment using RECIST1.1 and modified RECIST1.1 (mRECIST1.1, measuring the single largest lesion per organ) in advanced non-small cell lung cancer (aNSCLC) patients undergoing anti-PD-1/PD-L1 monotherapy.Methods:Concordance of radiologic response categorization between RECIST1.1 and mRECIST1.

pmc-10623108.title: The effect of host tissue and radiation on fat-graft survival: A comparative experimental study
pmc-10623108.creator: Antonios Tsimponis, Dimitrios Dionyssiou, Theodora Papamitsou, Efterpi Demiri
pmc-10623108.description: SummaryBecause lipofilling is often associated with various reconstructive procedures, especially breast reconstructions, improving fat-graft retention remains a major concern for plastic surgeons. We conducted an experimental protocol in a rat model simulating an autologous breast reconstruction method using the fat-augmented latissimus dorsi myocutaneous (LDM) flap.

pmc-10668332.title: Association between serum Klotho concentration and hyperlipidemia in adults: a cross-sectional study from NHANES 2007–2016
pmc-10668332.creator: Shaohua Yan, Wei Luo, Li Lei, Qiuxia Zhang, Jiancheng Xiu
pmc-10668332.description: ObjectiveThe Klotho protein is a well-documented anti-aging protein known for its diverse biological functions. Hyperlipidemia is an established independent risk factor for various chronic diseases. However, there is limited understanding of the connection between Klotho and hyperlipidemia. The aim was to assess the association between serum Klotho levels and hyperlipidemia among adults.

pmc-11688722.title: GAIT SPEED MODERATES EFFICACY OF HOME-BASED EXERCISE ON FALLS IN OLDER ADULTS WITH PREVIOUS FALL
pmc-11688722.creator: Jordyn Rice, Ryan Falck, Jennifer Davis, Larry Dian, Kenneth Madden, Wendy Cook, Karim Miran-Khan, Teresa Liu-Ambrose
pmc-11688722.description: Exercise is an evidence-based strategy for preventing falls. However, its efficacy may vary based on individual characteristics, like gait speed. We performed a secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial, to assess if baseline gait speed moderated the effects of an exercise program on subsequent falls among older adults.

pmc-12362353.title: In utero exposure to extreme heat increases neonatal mortality
pmc-12362353.creator: Tenghui Wang, Jiafu An, Bin Chen, Chris John Webster, Peng Gong, Chen Lin, Edson Severnini
pmc-12362353.description: Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) has had the highest neonatal mortality rate in the world for the past few decades. In 2021, 27 infants died within the first month of life for every thousand live births in SSA, accounting for 54% of infant deaths (0–12 months) on the continent.

pmc-12396475.title: Stepwise targeting hyaluronic acid-based polymeric prodrug for acute kidney injury and prevents its progression to chronic kidney disease
pmc-12396475.creator: Li-Bin Zhou, Xuan-Ze Peng, Hui-Min Long, Jing-Bo Hu, Jian-Ting Xu
pmc-12396475.description: Acute kidney injury (AKI) is characterized by a sudden decline in kidney function, often due to ischemia-reperfusion or nephrotoxic drugs. A key factor in AKI development is mitochondrial dysfunction, which disrupts energy and oxygen supply, increases ROS generation, and triggers inflammation. Addressing AKI through mitochondrial targeting remains challenging.

pmc-12471756.title: Effects of Tensile Specimen Geometry and Gripping System on the Mechanical Stability of Ausferrite in Austempered Ductile Irons
pmc-12471756.creator: Lun Fu, Manuel Schiralli, Maurizio Vedani, Jakob Olofsson, Marcin Górny, Parnian Govahi, Riccardo Donnini, Maria Losurdo, Giuliano Angella, Alexander Yu Churyumov
pmc-12471756.description: Different combinations of round and flat tensile specimens for different gripping systems of Austempered Ductile Irons (ADIs) were produced from the same 25 mm Y-block castings to investigate the effect of the specimen geometry and gripping system on the tensile mechanical properties of ADIs.

pmc-12538741.title: Identification of PP2C gene family and its role in stress and adversity based on T2T flax (Linum usitatissimum L.) genome
pmc-12538741.creator: Jianyu Lu, Hang Wang, Jinxi Li, Hanlu Wu, Yifei Wang, RuiDong Sun, Michael K. Deyholos, Xiaonan Wang, Jun Zhang, Yan Gu, Jian Zhang
pmc-12538741.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The PP2C gene family plays crucial roles in plant growth, development, and responses to biotic/abiotic stresses. Flax (Linum usitatissimum L.), as an important oilseed and fiber crop, lacks comprehensive characterization of its PP2C genes. In this study, we conducted a genome-wide bioinformatics analysis of the PP2C gene family in flax using the Telomere to Telomere (T2T) genome assembly, identifying 117 LuPP2C genes. Phylogenetic analysis classified these LuPP2C proteins into 11 distinct subclades.

pmc-12727974.title: Lentinan inhibits colorectal cancer stemness by binding CD133 and suppressing the CD133/p85/p-AKT signaling axis
pmc-12727974.creator: Yan Liu, Lufei Yang, Junxi Liu, Zihao He, Jingyi Wang, Yu Zhang, Kaiping Wang, Jinglin Wang
pmc-12727974.description: BackgroundColorectal cancer (CRC) ranks third in the global cancer incidence rate worldwide. Cancer stem cells (CSCs) are key drivers of CRC recurrence, metastasis, and therapy resistance, while therapies against them remain limited. Lentinan is widely recognized for its strong immune-enhancing and broad-spectrum directly antitumor activities, however, whether it has potential for cancer stemness remains unknown.

pmc-13265167.title: A prognostic model for head and neck squamous cell carcinoma based on eosinophil extracellular trap related genes
pmc-13265167.creator: Chuyu Han, Xuecheng Luo, Shouyin Xiao, Jiaou Lv, Bin Wang, Zhilin Li
pmc-13265167.description: BackgroundHead and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is one of the most prevalent malignant tumors worldwide and presents significant challenges due to its high rates of recurrence, metastasis, and poor prognosis. Emerging evidence suggests that eosinophil extracellular traps (EETs)-related genes may play a crucial role in tumor progression and aggressiveness.

pmc-13313910.title: Comparative ex vivo 7T MRI study of renal microstructural changes in cats with and without chronic kidney disease
pmc-13313910.creator: Takumi Matsuura, Hiroshi Satoh, Masaaki Katayama
pmc-13313910.description: Background:Seven-tesla magnetic resonance imaging (7T MRI) noninvasively detects microstructural changes associated with chronic kidney disease (CKD). Using animal-specific coils is often necessary to obtain high resolution and to minimize artifacts from breathing and heartbeat, even under anesthesia. However, in feline medicine, this ultra-high-field imaging has not been investigated either in vivo or even ex vivo using explanted organs.

pmc-13397626.title: Global inventory and audit of road injury data systems: a descriptive study using the Road Injury Chain of Survival Framework
pmc-13397626.creator: Tim Nutbeam, Emily Foote, Lauren R Rodgers, Rob Fenwick, Willem Stassen
pmc-13397626.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundRoad injury causes an estimated 1.19 million deaths annually and tens of millions of non-fatal injuries worldwide. Despite this burden, post-collision data remain fragmented across police, transport, and health sectors, impeding system-level improvement. The recently proposed Road Injury Chain of Survival framework provides a structure for mapping data needs across five sequential links: Early Recognition, Early Rescue, Early Initial Care, Early Transport, and Early Hospital Care & Rehabilitation.

pmc-13620829.title: A Case of Proximal Humerus Fracture Metastasis due to Clear Cell Renal Carcinoma Treated With Modular Hemiarthroplasty
pmc-13620829.creator: Gianfranco Puddu, Marco Piras, Stefano Congia, Shashank Kaushik

pmc-13676178.title: The Paul Glaucoma Implant versus the Ahmed and Baerveldt Glaucoma Implants: A Systematic Review and Bayesian Network Meta-Analysis
pmc-13676178.creator: Mohamed N Elshabrawi, Bara M Hammadeh, Ayodeji Arobo, Nader Elfar, Elsayed S Moubarak, Rami Al-Dwairi, Seren Al Beiruti, Hashem Abu Serhan
pmc-13676178.description: PurposeTo compare the efficacy and safety of the Paul Glaucoma Implant (PGI) with those of the two established glaucoma drainage devices, the Ahmed Glaucoma Valve (AGV) and the Baerveldt Glaucoma Implant (BGI).MethodsPubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, Cochrane CENTRAL, ClinicalTrials.gov, ScienceDirect and Google Scholar were searched.
